name: Their Holidays
source:
Levi doesn't celebrate anything in the winter, but now that he's in a relationship he kinda has to celebrate, and it doesn't help that his partners celebrate different holidays too.  Now he has to celebrate two holidays he's never celebrated before in one day.

A polyamorous holiday celebration with three people who love each other a lot. 

[From [url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/the-holidays]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
利威尔在冬天不会庆祝任何事情，但现在他已经恋爱了，他有点必须庆祝，而他的伴侣也庆祝不同的节日也无济于事。现在他必须在一天内庆祝两个他以前从未庆祝过的节日。

三个相爱的人一起庆祝多角恋的节日。

[来自[url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/the-holidays]Itch.io[/url]]
